details.description: Badshah kasuri methi is a good taste enhancer. It adds flavour and texture to vegetables, lentils and pulses. This culinary gem imparts a savoury-nutty flavour to dishes, ranging from curries to doughs for bread like parathas. Its versatility enhances vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes alike, adding depth and complexity with a mere sprinkle. Beyond its culinary uses, Kasuri Methi is celebrated for its health benefits, including lowering cholesterol, aiding digestion, and reducing inflammation. A staple in any spice cabinet, it's a bridge to authentic Indian flavours.
